title: Ex 7.2 (⇐, by contrapositive) · If 3x + 6 is odd, then x is odd
prompt: Let $x$ be an integer. Exercise 7.2 says $x$ is odd if and only if $3x + 6$ is odd. This problem is one direction of that if-and-only-if: prove that if $3x + 6$ is odd, then $x$ is odd. Use contrapositive proof: show that if $x$ is even, then $3x + 6$ is even. (The forward (⇒) direction is a separate problem.)
answer_format: A structured proof: let, case, expr and witness steps (notes optional). No final answer box.
hints: The contrapositive is: if x is even, then 3x + 6 is even.
solution: Contrapositive: if $x$ is even, then $3x + 6$ is even.
So if $3x + 6$ is odd, then $x$ is odd. $\blacksquare$

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words. Uses if-and-only-if proof (Section 7.1): this is the converse (⇐) direction, by contrapositive (Section 5.1), with Definitions 4.1, 4.2 (even, odd).
